name: Byteplugs Login Shop
author: BytePlugs

sections.description:
Byteplugs Login to Shop adds a mandatory authentication layer to your WooCommerce store, requiring users to log in or create an account before adding items to their cart or making a purchase. Fully compatible with WooCommerce, this free plugin is our gift to you.

Features

  • 3 beautiful login/register templates (Modern, Minimal, Elegant)
  • Customizable colors for each template
  • Mobile responsive design
  • AJAX form submission
  • Seamless WooCommerce integration
  • User-friendly settings page
  • Clean and modern design

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/byteplugs-login-shop directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the WooCommerce > Login to Shop screen to configure the plugin
  4. Choose your preferred template and customize colors
sections.faq:
Does this work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with any properly coded WooCommerce theme.

Can I customize the colors?

Yes, you can customize the primary, secondary, background, and text colors from the settings page.

Is it mobile responsive?

Yes, all templates are fully responsive and work great on mobile devices.

Does it support translation?

Yes, the plugin is fully translatable and comes with a .pot file for translations.
